text:
Nikhil: Dropping the new catalog frames from design-review. Two quick asks: where to anchor the latency badge so it's unambiguous, and how to show a pinned model version without adding noise. Figma: https://figma.redwood/mock/catalog-ux-2026

Zoe: If latency is left of the name it reads as part of the model identity (good). Prefer label: "P99 120ms" rather than "Perf". Include an icon so color isn't the only signal. :bar_chart:

Marta: For pinned versions, avoid permanent pin icons. Show a secondary line under the name: e.g., "v3.2 • pinned 2026-02-14" in italics; reveal a more explicit pin affordance on hover/focus to edit. Keeps rows clean.

Evan: Compact rows are nice for scan but break multi-select. Make the compare checkbox sticky left and ensure a visible floating CTA (e.g., "Compare (2)") when selections >=2. Keyboard users should hit Tab to land on that CTA.

a11y-checker: Flag: current badge contrast 3.0:1. Requirement: >=4.5:1 for legible small text. Also: non-text icons need aria-labels; ensure the pinned-state change is announced via aria-live.

Zoe: Search placeholder suggestion: "Search models, tasks, tags (press /)". Also make filter chips 44px min touch target and include clear tooltips for the 'x'.

Marta: Copy nit: prefer "Pinned version" to "Snapshot" 1; clearer for PMs. If default is latest, show "Latest (default)" inline to reduce confusion.

Nikhil: Good set of asks. Plan: move badge left with text+icon, switch copy to "P99" label, timestamp-line for pinned state, sticky checkbox + floating compare CTA, and a11y fixes (contrast, aria-live, focus styles). I'll push updated frames by EOD and tag you all. Thanks! :thumbsup:
